econometric_drivers.title: Chicagoland Multi-Tier Fuel Taxes & Cross-State Border Arbitrage
econometric_drivers.description: Models commuter fuel purchasing substitution between Cook County, IL (subject to state, county, municipal fuel taxes plus up to 10.25% composite sales tax) and Northwest Indiana (Lake and Porter counties) driven by a persistent $0.35-$0.55/gal cross-border retail price differential along the I-80/I-90/I-94 corridors.

refining_logistics.title: Great Lakes Refining Complex & Midwest Pipeline Confluence
refining_logistics.description: Chicagoland rack supplies are anchored by BP's 435,000 bpd Whiting IN refinery (6th largest in the US), CITGO's 177,000 bpd Lemont refinery along the Des Plaines River, and ExxonMobil's 251,000 bpd Joliet refinery. Inbound Western Canadian crude arrives via Enbridge pipelines, while outbound refined product disperses via the Wolverine, West Shore, and Badger pipelines.
refining_logistics.primary_refinery: BP Whiting IN Refinery (435 kbpd) & CITGO Lemont (177 kbpd)

tax_structure.title: Multi-Layered Municipal Tax Structure & Statutory Fees
tax_structure.description: Illinois state motor fuel tax ($0.470/gal, CPI-indexed), Cook County tax ($0.060/gal), City of Chicago fuel tax ($0.080/gal), environmental/UST fees ($0.011/gal), and Federal excise tax ($0.184/gal), combined with state and local sales tax on motor fuel, creates a statutory tax load exceeding $1.00/gal inside Chicago compared to ~$0.55/gal across the Indiana state line.
tax_structure.notes: Base statutory fuel tax of $0.805/gal (excluding local sales tax) with $0.40/gal spread against Northwest Indiana

infrastructure_delivery.title: Chicago CBOB Delivery Hub & Rack Margin Dynamics
infrastructure_delivery.equation_latex: \text{Rack Margin}_{\text{Chicago}} = P_{\text{Chicago Retail}} - P_{\text{Chicago CBOB Spot}} = \$3.850 - \$2.325 = \$1.525/\text{gal}
infrastructure_delivery.description: Reflects the Chicago CBOB wholesale pipeline spot benchmark at the Hammond/Lemont terminal complexes, RFG 7.4 psi summer volatility compliance, and retail rack pass-through.
